title: NC replication run + bundle-vs-rationale-class fix to the extraction prompt
summary: Replicated the NC extraction (11 docs, run 2) against the 2026-07-21 run 1 — criterion 283/284, action 284/284 — and confirmed against the live FNA site that NC has no post-FY2016 documents in either stream. Then rewrote the group-splitting instruction so groups[] is the evaluated SET rather than a shared-rationale class, reasoning from the rule and the arithmetic instead of phrase-matching; verified the ND/WI gold sheets already use this convention.
